basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, has invited online applications for 2 Project Associate-I - Research posts in the DBT-sponsored project "IndiaCAN-Twin: Towards AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Early Detection and Personalized Care in Indian Oral Cancer". The consolidated compensation is up to Rs. 31,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience, for 24 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The application fee is printed as 0 for all categories, and the last date is 20 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The notice states that the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

how_to_apply: Applications are invited online, and the last date of application is November 20, 2026. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. The notice prints the application fee as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST, and also gives this bank account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking:
Bank name: State Bank of India (00202)
Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302
Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account

content_sections.heading: IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-I - Research at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the interview date or the selection stages.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy
IndiaCAN-Twin: Towards AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Early Detection and Personalized Care in Indian Oral Cancer (Project Code – R/IND)
DBT, New Delhi (Government of India, Ministry of Science and Technology, Department of Biotechnology)
24 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Up to Rs. 31,000 per month, consolidated (depending on qualification and experience)
28 years (age as on last date of advertisement)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate should be excellent in Programming and Data Structures, Probability and Statistics, and Discrete Maths. The candidate should preferably have a GATE score and a CGPA > 8.0. The notice states that the qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.essential_qualification: Four years Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Masters Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / B. Pharm or Bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or from a recognized University or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Consolidated Compensation is printed as up to Rs. 31,000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. Under the qualification details, the notice also prints these amounts: 37,000/- + HRA to scholars who are selected through (a) CSIR-UGC NET or GATE, or (b) a selection process through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies and institutions. 28,000/- + HRA for others who do not fall under the above. The assignment is temporary, for 24 months or until the project is terminated, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Kharagpur Project Associate-I - Research
content_sections.text: Applications are invited online, and the last date of application is November 20, 2026. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form. The notice prints the application fee as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST, and also gives this bank account for fee deposit through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202) Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302 Name of bank account: IIT SRIC-OM Account Account No.: 39502115210 IFSC code: SBIN0000202 SWIFT code: SBININBB339

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview but states that meeting the minimum qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for it. It does not describe the selection stages or the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate-I - Research posts are advertised by IIT Kharagpur?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 2 posts of Project Associate-I - Research in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is November 20, 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a four years Bachelors Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Masters Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / B. Pharm or Bachelors degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine or from a recognized University or equivalent.

faq.answer: The post's Age Limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules, if any.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the tenure?
faq.answer: The tenure is 24 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. It is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project.

faq.answer: The post is for the DBT-sponsored project "IndiaCAN-Twin: Towards AI-Powered Digital Twin Platform for Early Detection and Personalized Care in Indian Oral Cancer" (Project Code – R/IND).
